privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Duo Finance Privacy Policy. Last updated: [PUBLICATION DATE].

This Policy explains what personal data Duo Finance processes, for what purposes, on which legal basis, with whom we share it, how long we keep it and how you can exercise your rights, under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, “GDPR”).

1. Controller

The controller is [FULL NAME OR COMPANY NAME], [REGISTRATION / TAX ID NUMBER], with its address at [FULL ADDRESS] (“we”, “us”). For any privacy matter, write to [CONTACT E-MAIL]. [IF THE CONTROLLER IS NOT ESTABLISHED IN THE EU: Our representative in the European Union under Article 27 GDPR is [REPRESENTATIVE NAME AND ADDRESS].]

2. Data we process

Registration data: display name, e-mail address, language, password (stored only as an irreversible cryptographic hash using Argon2id, never in readable form), e-mail confirmation date, version and date of acceptance of the Terms of Use, access role and, for security, the number of unsuccessful login attempts and any temporary lock.

Financial data you record: entries (type, amount, date, description), categories, names of the accounts you create, budgets and recurring rules, and who created each record in a shared account. This data may reveal aspects of your personal life. We recommend that you do not include information about health, religion, political opinions or other special categories of data in descriptions.

Invitations: the e-mail address of the person you invite to the shared account, used only to send the invitation, which is valid for 7 days.

Waitlist and beta access: the e-mail address and language of people who join the waitlist and, if approved, the access code tied to that address. The code itself is never stored in readable form.

Technical data: when you visit the site, the server logs the IP address, date and time, the page requested, the result of the request, the referring page and the browser identification. Sessions use tokens that we store only as cryptographic hashes.

E-mails: to send the service’s e-mails, our e-mail provider receives the recipient address, the message content and the delivery status.

We do not collect payment data, bank details, banking credentials or identity documents.

3. Purposes and legal bases

Providing the service (creating and maintaining your account, storing and displaying your financial data, generating recurring entries, sharing the account with the other member, sending confirmation, password reset and invitation e-mails): performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Managing the waitlist and sending access codes at your request: steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b)).

Protecting the service and its users (technical logs, temporary lock after unsuccessful login attempts, request limits, backups, incident investigation): legitimate interest in keeping the service secure and available (Article 6(1)(f)). You may object to this processing (section 9).

Complying with legal obligations and responding to requests from authorities: legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c)).

We do not use your data for advertising, do not sell it, do not build marketing profiles and do not make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects on you (Article 22 GDPR).

4. Cookies and browser storage

We use a single, strictly necessary cookie: the session cookie that keeps you logged in. It is HttpOnly (not accessible to scripts), secure (only sent over HTTPS), restricted to this site and valid for up to 30 days, or until you log out. In your browser’s local storage we keep only your theme preference and a note that you have completed the initial setup.

We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party cookies, or any tracking tools. Because these items are strictly necessary for the service you requested, they do not require consent (Article 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC).

5. Who we share data with

We share data only with providers that help us run the service, act on our instructions and are bound by data processing agreements (Article 28 GDPR): (a) Amazon Web Services, for hosting the server, the database and the backups, in the European Union region in Paris, France; (b) Resend, for sending the service’s e-mails; (c) Cloudflare, for the domain name service (DNS) [and, if enabled, for protecting and delivering the site’s traffic].

Data in a shared account is visible to the other member of that account, as that is the purpose of the service. We may disclose data to authorities where required by law. We do not sell or pass on data to third parties for their own purposes.

6. Transfers outside the European Economic Area

Hosting and backups are located in the European Union. Some providers, such as our e-mail provider, may process data in the United States or other countries outside the European Economic Area. In those cases, the transfer relies on an adequacy decision of the European Commission (including the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, where the provider is certified) or on standard contractual clauses approved by the Commission (Article 46 GDPR). [CONFIRM THE MECHANISM FOR EACH PROVIDER.] You may request a copy of the applicable safeguards through the contact channel.

7. How long we keep data

Registration and financial data: for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, it is erased from the service immediately, subject to the shared account rules described in the Terms of Use.

Backups: daily database backups are kept for 30 days and server images for 7 days, after which they are deleted automatically. Deleted data disappears from backups no later than 30 days after deletion.

Sessions and links sent by e-mail: the session token is valid for up to 30 days, the e-mail confirmation link for 24 hours, the password reset link for 1 hour and the invitation for 7 days. The hashes of these tokens are erased together with the account.

Waitlist and access codes: for as long as the beta phase lasts, or until you ask for removal.

Technical logs: overwritten automatically on a size-based rotation and kept no longer than [MAXIMUM PERIOD, FOR EXAMPLE 30 DAYS], unless needed to investigate a specific security incident.

We may keep data for longer where required by law or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims, only for as long as necessary.

8. Security

We apply technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk, including: always-encrypted communication (HTTPS); passwords and tokens stored only as cryptographic hashes; encrypted backups in private storage; administrative access to the server restricted and protected by keys; and access to data limited to what is strictly necessary to operate, support and protect the service. If a personal data breach occurs, we will notify the supervisory authority and, where there is a high risk to you, inform you as well, under Articles 33 and 34 GDPR.

9. Your rights

Under the GDPR, you have the right to: access your data and obtain a copy (Article 15); rectify inaccurate data (Article 16); request erasure (Article 17); request restriction of processing (Article 18); receive the data you provided to us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller (Article 20); and object to processing based on our legitimate interest (Article 21).

You can edit your profile and delete your account directly in Settings. For the other rights, including portability, write to [CONTACT E-MAIL]. We will reply within one month. For complex requests, this period may be extended by two further months, and we will let you know if that happens. We may ask for information to confirm your identity before replying. Exercising these rights is free of charge.

If you consider that the processing of your data infringes the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement.

10. Minimum age

Duo Finance is intended for people aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you become aware that a minor has created an account, let us know so that we can delete it.

11. Changes to this Policy

We may update this Policy to reflect changes to the service or the law. The current version will always be on this page, with the date of the last update. For material changes, we will notify you by e-mail or in the service before they take effect.

12. Contact

For questions or requests about privacy, write to [CONTACT E-MAIL].

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
Duo Finance Terms of Use. Version 2026-11, effective from [PUBLICATION DATE].

1. Acceptance

These Terms of Use govern access to and use of Duo Finance, available at duofinance.dev.br. By creating an account, you enter into a contract with us on the terms set out here. Please also read the Privacy Policy, which explains how we process your personal data. If you do not agree with these Terms, do not use the service. The version you accepted and the date of acceptance are recorded in your account.

2. Who provides the service

Duo Finance is provided by [FULL NAME OR COMPANY NAME], [REGISTRATION / TAX ID NUMBER], with its address at [FULL ADDRESS] (“we”, “us”). We are the controller of the personal data processed in the service, within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, “GDPR”). [IF THE CONTROLLER IS NOT ESTABLISHED IN THE EU: Our representative in the European Union under Article 27 GDPR is [REPRESENTATIVE NAME AND ADDRESS].] Questions, requests and notices about these Terms should be sent to [CONTACT E-MAIL].

3. What Duo Finance is

Duo Finance is a financial organisation tool for couples. It lets you record income, expenses and transfers, categorise entries, set up recurring entries, define monthly budgets and follow a dashboard with the couple’s data.

Duo Finance is not a credit institution, payment institution or electronic money institution, and does not provide banking, payment, account information or investment services. The service does not connect to your bank accounts, does not move money and has no access to your banking credentials. The “bank accounts” you create in Duo Finance are only labels you use to organise your entries.

The information shown in the service is calculated from the data you enter yourself. It is not financial, accounting, tax or investment advice.

4. Beta phase

Duo Finance is in a closed beta. During this phase: (a) access requires an access code or an invitation from an existing member; the code is personal, may be tied to a specific e-mail address and may not be sold or passed on; (b) use is free of charge; (c) features may be added, changed or removed, and the service may experience instability, interruptions or maintenance, including without prior notice when urgent; (d) we may end the beta phase or the service itself; in that case we will notify you by e-mail at least 30 days in advance, so you can keep any information you want or exercise your right to data portability (section 8).

5. Registration and account security

You must be at least 18 years old to use Duo Finance. When registering, you agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date, including a valid e-mail address, which will be used to confirm your identity and send you communications about your account.

You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. Use a strong, unique password. If you suspect misuse, change your password immediately and let us know through the contact channel. For security reasons, access may be temporarily locked after several unsuccessful login attempts.

Each person may hold only one registration. Your registration is personal and non-transferable.

6. The couple’s shared account

Every registration starts with an individual account. You can invite one person by e-mail to share your account. A shared account has at most two members. You can only send invitations after confirming your e-mail address.

Both members of a shared account have equal access to all of its data: entries, categories, accounts, budgets and recurring rules. Both can create, edit and delete this data. By inviting someone or accepting an invitation, you agree to this sharing. When you record information that relates to the other person, you agree to do so only for the purpose of the couple’s joint financial management.

If you accept an invitation and your individual account already contains data beyond the default categories, that data will be permanently deleted after you expressly confirm it on screen. It is not transferred to the shared account.

Either member may leave the shared account at any time. The member who leaves receives a new, empty individual account, and all data stays in the account with the remaining member, including entries created by the member who left. If a member deletes their registration, the shared account’s data remains available to the other member, and records created by the departed member are shown as “Former member”, without that person’s name or e-mail address.

Disagreements between members about the shared account’s data must be resolved between them. We do not arbitrate disputes between members and do not restore data deleted by one of them.

7. Acceptable use

You agree to use Duo Finance only for personal or couple financial organisation, in accordance with the law and these Terms. You must not: (a) access or attempt to access accounts, data or areas of the system that are not yours; (b) test, exploit or circumvent security mechanisms, usage limits or access controls, except through responsible vulnerability disclosure via the contact channel; (c) use bots, scripts or other automated means to overload, copy or extract data from the service; (d) use the service for unlawful activities, including fraud or money laundering, or to store unlawful content or content that infringes the rights of others; (e) resell, sublicense or make the service available to third parties; (f) copy, modify, decompile or attempt to obtain the service’s source code, except where expressly permitted by law.

8. Your data and data protection

The data you record in Duo Finance belongs to you and, in the case of a shared account, to its members. We process this data only to provide, maintain and protect the service. The legal basis is the performance of the contract formed by these Terms (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), together with compliance with legal obligations and our legitimate interests in security, as described in the Privacy Policy. We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising or profiling.

The data is hosted in the European Union (France). Where a service provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, for example to send e-mails, we rely on the safeguards in Chapter V GDPR, such as standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission. Details are in the Privacy Policy.

Under the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. To exercise these rights, use the features in Settings (for example, editing your profile or deleting your account) or write to [CONTACT E-MAIL]. We will reply within one month. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement.

You are responsible for the accuracy of what you record.

9. Plans and future charges

During the beta phase, use is free of charge. We may introduce paid plans in the future. If we do: (a) we will notify you by e-mail and in the service at least 30 days in advance, stating prices (including taxes), conditions and what changes; (b) no charge will be made unless you expressly subscribe to a paid plan; (c) if you do not wish to subscribe, you may keep using whatever is offered free of charge, if anything, or delete your account; (d) subscriptions will have their own conditions, presented before you complete them. If you are a consumer, you will have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason, under Directive 2011/83/EU and the national law implementing it. If you ask for the paid service to start before that period ends, you may be charged an amount proportionate to the service already provided.

10. Availability, conformity and backups

We use reasonable efforts to keep the service available and your data protected, including encrypted connections and daily backups kept for up to 30 days. Even so, no system is immune to failure. We recommend that you keep your own records of important financial information.

We may carry out scheduled or emergency maintenance. If data is lost, we will do our best to restore it from the most recent available backup. If you are a consumer, these Terms do not exclude the legal guarantee of conformity for digital content and digital services under Directive (EU) 2019/770 and the national law implementing it.

11. Intellectual property

Duo Finance, including its brand, name, logo, interface, texts, code and other elements, belongs to [FULL NAME OR COMPANY NAME] or its licensors. These Terms grant you a personal, limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable licence to use the service in accordance with these rules. No other rights are transferred.

12. Liability

We are liable in accordance with applicable law. We do not limit or exclude our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for intent or gross negligence, or for any other liability that cannot be limited by law.

Outside those cases, and to the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for: (a) financial decisions made on the basis of the information shown in the service; (b) data entered incorrectly by users; (c) misuse of your account by third parties to whom you gave access, or your failure to keep your password confidential; (d) actions by a member of a shared account concerning its data; (e) unavailability caused by events beyond our reasonable control, such as failures of internet, hosting or e-mail providers.

If you are a consumer, nothing in these Terms affects the rights granted to you by the consumer protection law of your country of residence that cannot be excluded by contract.

13. Termination and account deletion

You may terminate the contract at any time, free of charge, by deleting your account in Settings. Deletion is permanent: (a) if you are the only member of the account, all of its data is erased; (b) if the account is shared, the account’s data stays with the other member, as described in section 6, and your registration data (name, e-mail, password) is erased.

Deleted data disappears from the service immediately and is removed from backups within 30 days, except for data we must keep longer to comply with a legal obligation, as described in the Privacy Policy.

We may suspend or terminate the access of anyone who materially breaches these Terms or the law, or where necessary to protect the service, other users or third parties. Where possible and permitted by law, we will notify you in advance, state the reason and give you an opportunity to respond.

14. Communications

We will send e-mails needed for the service to work: registration confirmation, password reset, invitations, access codes and important notices about your account or these Terms. These messages are part of the service and are not used for advertising.

15. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms for valid reasons, such as changes to the service, to the law or for security reasons. The current version will always be available on this page, with its effective date. For material changes, we will notify you by e-mail at least 30 days in advance and, where required, ask for your acceptance again. If you do not agree with the new version, you may terminate the contract free of charge by deleting your account before it takes effect.

16. General provisions

If any clause of these Terms is held invalid, the remaining clauses continue to apply. Failure to enforce any clause does not constitute a waiver of it. These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy, form the entire agreement between you and us regarding the use of Duo Finance. These Terms are available in Portuguese and English; in case of discrepancy, the version in the language you use in the service prevails.

17. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the law of [COUNTRY]. If you are a consumer, this choice does not deprive you of the protection of the mandatory rules of the law of the country of your habitual residence (Article 6 of Regulation (EC) No 593/2008, “Rome I”). You may bring proceedings in the courts of the country of your habitual residence, and we may bring proceedings against you only in those courts (Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012, “Brussels I bis”). You may also turn to an alternative dispute resolution body for consumer disputes in your country.

18. Contact

For questions, requests or notices about these Terms, write to [CONTACT E-MAIL].
